purpose: Replace the old screen-space rotating-rifle player path with selected M2 and A2 READY, MOVE, and FIRE composite animation across 120 real world-yaw angles while preserving separate 3D source objects and gameplay invariants.
camera: one fixed orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: 120 real world-yaw samples from 0 through 357 degrees in exact three-degree steps for every animation frame
lighting: approved M2 fixed-world key, fill, and rim lighting, identical across all actions and angles
prompt: Bake the selected M2 industrial salvage alloy player and independent BoneAttachment3D rifle in approved A2 motion. READY uses the accepted neutral pose; MOVE uses six complete gait phases; FIRE uses six recoil and two-stage recovery phases. Render every frame at 120 true world yaws with one exact 45-degree camera and one shared 3D depth buffer.
negative_constraints: no screen-space weapon rotation, separate 2D rifle spin, camera orbit, mirrored directions, or one-direction runtime exception
no body, rifle, grip, M2 material, camera, framing, lighting, collision, movement, damage, or control drift
no broad translucency, detached hand, floating stock, missing frame, cropped silhouette, or collapsed profile
no Dasher animation, dash animation invention, hit animation invention, environment work, or UI work in this increment
